description: This file defines an interface for a pseudo-random sequence generator compliant with TS38.211, including methods for initialization, state management, sequence generation, and XOR operations on various data formats.

classes.name: pseudo_random_generator
classes.description: Interface class for pseudo-random sequence generators, providing methods for initialization, state management, sequence generation, and XOR operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a seed value.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the generator with a specific internal state.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current internal state of the generator.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the generator's internal state by a specified number of steps.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: XORs the generated sequence with a packed bit buffer.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: XORs the generated sequence with an unpacked bit buffer.

methods.name: apply_xor
methods.description: XORs the generated sequence with a sequence of log-likelihood ratios.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a floating-point pseudo-random sequence with specified amplitude.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a complex floating-point pseudo-random sequence with specified amplitude.
